Charged Clamp.name: Charged Clamp
Charged Clamp.description: The user marks a target within five meters and a wall, girder or car with opposite magnetic poles laced with live current. If the target wears metal armor, gear or cuffs, they slam against the surface and stick fast while a low hum numbs their arms: they cannot move from the spot until they wrench free with a hard effort or the user releases the field. Targets with no metal on them are not held. Strain: moderate.
